title: Chapter 321 The Next Time We Meet
content:
Chapter 321 The Next Time We Meet

"It's you? Chu Lingsheng!"

Not only Chen Mingyu, no one present expected that the person who ended Chen Mingyu would be Chu Lingsheng.

At this moment, Chu Lingsheng had a faint smile on his face.

"My Tiandi Academy is not easy to mess with."

"You! Sneak attack behind your back, a despicable villain!"

Blood flowed out of Chen Mingyu's mouth, and the hatred in his eyes had almost turned into substance, but in the end, his consciousness gradually became blurred.

Finally, a plop.

Chen Mingyu fell to the ground.

In this way, the 19th place on the monster list, and the gun god Chen Mingyu fell.

But when he heard Chen Mingyu's final last words, Chu Lingsheng smiled faintly and said, "Ah yes, yes, yes, I'm a villain."

At the same time, somewhere in the fairyland.

A white-haired old man sitting quietly holding his breath suddenly opened his eyes, and a murderous intent suddenly soared into the sky, dyeing the entire sky red.

"Who is it! Who killed Wu'er?!"

......

With Chen Mingyu's death, the rest of them slowly breathed a sigh of relief.

They won this battle.

To be precise, they won the Tiandi Academy.

"Chu Lingsheng, you kid really know how to steal the head."

At this time, Tang Hao looked at Chu Lingsheng and snorted.

It is obviously still in mind that Chu Lingsheng escaped before.

Hearing Tang Hao's words, Chu Lingsheng stretched out his index finger and shook it, saying, "Tang Hao, you don't understand this. I am not good at fighting head-on. Stealing people behind my back is my way."

Hearing this, everyone rolled their eyes.

At this time, Chu Lingsheng coughed lightly again and then looked at Lu Xue.

"Junior Sister Lu Xue, it is mainly your credit for killing Chen Mingyu. If I succeed, I just want to make up for it."

Hearing this, Lu Xue said expressionlessly, "You want me to take the blame."

Take the blame.

Everyone was stunned and suddenly reacted.

Yes, how could there be no strong people behind him like Chen Mingyu?

Suddenly, they also understood why Chu Lingsheng suddenly became so humble.

It turned out that I wanted Lu Xue to take the blame.

For a moment, Xiao Luo and the others looked at Chu Lingsheng and their faces became unkind.

At this time, Lu Xue waved her hand.

"It doesn't matter."

Anyway, she is no longer afraid now.

What's more, there is no one behind her.

"Let's do this. How can you keep Chen Mingyu's death confidential? It's a shame for me."

At this time, Tang Hao spoke.

Everyone was silent.

Ye Wuwei sighed and said, "Well, I'll forget about this. After all, killing Chen Mingyu is also my part."

Chu Xingyue nodded and said, "Yes, but what I give you is not your face, but hers."

After saying that, Chu Xingyue looked at Lu Xue.

Hearing this, Tang Hao's mouth twitched slightly. At this moment, everyone's center had already become Lu Xue without realizing it.

Lu Xue naturally would not remain indifferent to this, and then she nodded slightly to Chu Xingyue in the distance, "Thank you."

"My little master, have you obtained the inheritance of this bronze palace?"

At this time, Ao Qing stepped forward and said carelessly.

As soon as this question arose, everyone looked away at Lu Xue again.

Yes, they almost forgot this.

There is also the inheritance of the bronze palace.

Lu Xue has improved so much, has she really obtained the inheritance of this bronze palace?

Faced with the doubts in everyone's hearts, Lu Xue shook her head slightly.

"That is not the inheritance of the bronze palace, it is just a resource, and it is far behind the inheritance."

As soon as these words came out, some people sighed and some people were glad.

Lu Xue can improve so much, but it is mainly up to her.

She practices a lot on weekdays.

But he has been stuck at the peak of the Immortal Lord Realm.

Now that he has obtained an opportunity to make a successful breakthrough, all the accumulated foundation has exploded, Lu Xue has reached the ninth level of the Immortal Saint Realm.

Meanwhile, in the dim room.

The phantom looked at Lu Xue at this time and nodded slightly, "It seems that I already know how to choose."

On the side, the relief in Lu Daosheng's eyes had almost turned into substance.

And at this moment, the entire bronze palace began to buzz.

The next moment, under the horrified gaze of everyone, the statue in the distance suddenly burst out with a dazzling light.

I saw a blurred phantom slowly emerged from above the statue.

Judging from its appearance, it is exactly the same as a bronze statue.

"The capable people in the fairy world are as numerous as the stars in the Milky Way."

The phantom smiled faintly and glanced at everyone present.

In an instant, everyone felt like they were seen through, and the awe in their hearts became stronger and stronger.

This is the owner of the Bronze Palace!

He suddenly appeared at this moment, obviously he was going to take some action.

As if seeing through what everyone was thinking, the phantom smiled and said, "You guessed it right. I do have the inheritance of this bronze palace in my hand. Of course, it can also be said to be my inheritance."

"Senior, I think that no one can do your inheritance except me."

As soon as the phantom finished speaking, Ye Wuwei stood up and said.

Everyone was a little unbelievable when they heard Ye Wuwei's shameless words.

This was the first time they knew that Ye Wuwei was so shameless.

Tang Hao gritted his teeth. He didn't even stand up and talk, you little bastard and still have the face to scream.

The phantom was also stunned at this moment, but then he smiled faintly and said, "You little guy is quite good at joking."

Immediately, he looked directly at Lu Xue.

At this time, although Ye Wuwei was also a little embarrassed, he was confused. Isn’t he a destiny person?

Isn’t this kind of inheritance given to people of destiny?

Could it be that handsome guy before was a liar? !

Thinking of this, Ye Wuwei was angry and was actually fooled.

"Lu Xue, you are qualified to obtain my inheritance. Of course, no one is more qualified than you."

After saying that, the phantom looked at the rest of the people.

"Are you dissatisfied?"

Hearing this, everyone lowered their heads slightly.

They really dare not compare with Lu Xue.

The Immortal Saint Realm is in the mid-stage fight against the Immortal Emperor Realm, but they can't do it anyway.

Seeing that everyone was not talking, the phantom nodded slightly.

With the phantom waved his hand gently, everyone in the Bronze Palace, except Lu Xue, was teleported out.

"Miss Lu, I will leave my inheritance to you. I hope that one day you can carry forward this inheritance."

After saying that, without waiting for Lu Xue to react, a ray of light immediately poured into Lu Xue's mind.

The next moment, Lu Xue suddenly felt a connection between her and the Bronze Palace.

The entire bronze palace suddenly became her private property.

At this moment, Lu Xue was a little unresponsive.

Don’t ask her if she wants it?

"Haha, I can finally go there with confidence."

The phantom suddenly burst into laughter, and then his figure slowly dissipated.

When he was in place, Lu Xue frowned slightly, thinking about something.

In a separate space.

Lu Daosheng looked at Lu Xue at this moment with a smile on his face.

At this time, the phantom suddenly appeared beside him.

Lu Daosheng glanced at him and said, "I should leave too."

Hearing this, the phantom smiled and said, "Don't you say goodbye to your daughter?"

"Haha, no,"

Before Lu Daosheng finished speaking, he was stunned.

"You know?"

The phantom sighed, "I'm not stupid, even a fool can see it."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng was speechless.

After a moment of silence, Lu Daosheng shook his head slightly.

"No need. When we meet next time, I think she is already at the peak of the fairy world and meet me in the posture of a winner."
